name: event-count-bind
description: updateEventRanges: the job event-count statement binds :pandaID, as the rest of the module does; on PostgreSQL its :PandaID was missing from the parameters (KeyError), so the job's nEvents never updated and each range update's answer carried a trailing False.

pandaserver/taskbuffer/db_proxy_mods/tas:
sqlS += "WHERE jediTaskID=:jediTaskID AND PandaID=:PandaID AND status IN (:esFinished,:esDone,:esMerged))*:nEvents "
            sqlS += "WHERE jediTaskID=:jediTaskID AND PandaID=:pandaID AND status IN (:esFinished,:esDone,:esMerged))*:nEvents "
